parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use correct trigonometric formulae to obtain an equation in $\tan\theta$, or equivalent in sines/cosines [M1*; printed examples include $(1-\tan^2\theta)/(2\tan\theta)=2\tan\theta$]. Obtain a correct simplified equation [A1], e.g. $5\tan^2\theta=1$, $\sin^2\theta=1/6$, or $\cos^2\theta=5/6$. Solve for $\theta$ [DM1 dependent on the first M1]. Obtain $24.1^\circ$ or $155.9^\circ$ [A1]. Obtain the second answer by $180^\circ-$ the first and no others in range [A1FT; accept $156^\circ$ but not $156.0^\circ$; both square-root branches must be considered when working in tangent or cosine]. Radian answers $0.421,2.72$ are treated as a misread: A0A1. Total 5.
